text:
Marta: FYI — Sapphire is asking for a reserved commit. They proposed 120k GPU-hours / month. Need ops + pricing input, and whether we can meet headroom + burst requirements.
Sam: Quick clarifying q — is that 120k across mixed instance types or a specific SKU?
Marta: They called out A10-series for latency-critical routes and cheaper T4s for background embed jobs. Their ask was expressed as an aggregate.
Ravi: Back-of-envelope: 120k A10-hours steady ~ 50 A10s running 24/7. We normally add maintenance/eviction headroom ~20%. So plan for ~60 GPUs steady.
Li: Reminder — us-west-2 capacity is forecasted to be constrained Q3 (supply down ~15%). We may need to design cross-region burst or suggest alternative SKUs.
Jordan: Cross-region burst will require routing + additional egress cost. Also model variants in other regions might be different, may affect latency/SLA. @Priya can Sapphire tolerate cross-region fallback for non-EU traffic?
Priya: They said EU customer data must stay in EU. For global traffic they said fallback to us is acceptable. So a split commit is plausible: EU reserved + US reserved.
ops-bot: [Auto] forecast-run completed: expected peak multiplier for Sapphire in Nov = 1.8x baseline (Black Friday style campaign).
Marta: Ok add seasonal multiplier 1.8. We need to convert baseline -> committed reserve including buffer and seasonal headroom.
Sam: Quick calc (rough):
```
base = 120000  # hours/month
seasonal = 1.8
buffer = 0.2  # maintenance + operational slack
reserved = int(base * seasonal * (1 + buffer))
# reserved = 259200 hours/month
```
Ravi: That result assumes every hour is on an A10. If we mix quantized int8 models / smaller T4s for non-critical traffic, effective GPU-hour consumption could drop ~25-35%.
Li: Cost sensitivity with Dedicated pricing (example A10 = $0.45 / GPU-hour): 259200 * 0.45 ≈ $116,640/mo. Current Sapphire spend target is closer to $90k/mo — large delta.
Marta: They’re offering a 24mo commitment in exchange for deeper discounts. We can propose: 12mo -> 10% off, 24mo -> 18% off, plus a pay-for-burst option.
Jordan: Operational note: firmware/driver rollouts typically take 3-7% capacity offline per AZ during a window. That needs to be accounted for in the operational buffer, not just billing buffer.
Priya: For EU-only customers we should have EU carve-out: suggest EU reserved 30k hours, US rest. That reduces cross-region traffic and legal risk.
Sam: Proposed packaged option to present to the customer:
- Reserved base: US 180k / EU 45k = 225k hours baseline
- Seasonal and ops buffer: 60% uplift aggregate -> ~360k hours/month reserved
- Burst pool: 10% above reserved at 1.5x rate
- 24mo discount: 18% on base rate
Ravi: I can produce an adjusted model that accounts for mixed SKU efficiencies (A10 vs T4) and quantization gains. Will drop a table.
Li: I'll run cost scenarios and show sensitivity to seasonal multiplier (1.3, 1.5, 1.8) and buffer (10-30%). Link to draft sheet when ready.
Priya: I'll review compliance wording for cross-region fallback and EU carveouts. Expect redlines.
Marta: Action items: Ravi -> capacity map + utilization numbers; Li -> cost sensitivity; Priya -> legal checks; Jordan -> ops constraints (eviction/maintenance profile); Sam -> pricing tiers and term sheet. I'll assemble proposal.
Ravi: I'll export current us-west/us-east/eu capacity map and 6-week availability forecast. Uploading to the proposal folder.
ops-bot: [Upload] sapphire-capacity-map.csv -> /mnt/forecasting/sapphire/1845012345/sapphire-capacity-map.csv
Li: Draft cost scenarios will include quantized model case (30% GPU hour reduction) + pure A10 case.
Marta: Goal — have a term sheet draft by EOD tomorrow. If we need to reduce the delta vs customer budget, we can propose lower base + larger burst or steeper discount on longer commitment.
Jordan: Heads-up — if they want fixed latency SLOs across regions we may need dedicated A10 pools per region which increases baseline.
Sam: Noted. I'll sketch two options: fixed latency SLO (dedicated per-region) vs soft SLO with fallbacks.
Marta: Thanks team. I'll sync with AE after we have the numbers. :thumbsup:
Jordan: :rocket:
Priya: +1
Marta: Uploading initial proposal skeleton now.
ops-bot: [Deploy] proposal-draft-v1 uploaded -> /mnt/proposals/sapphire/proposal-draft-v1-2026-03-18.pdf
